posts.body:
Hi
I'm an Agent for Tish Tash Toys, we specialise in traditional handpainted toys but do have a very large and exciting range of other toys suitable from birth.
I love the job, the toys and the hours to suit, I think I have found my calling in life!! 😀
Hopefully be speaking to lots of you soon x

hey, how you doing?
im a landlady and a mum to 2 little monsters, lol.
whats this toy thing all about? how does it work? my sister is in the first stages of opening her own toy shop (named after my dog!) she is 18 on the 22nd of this month, its very exciting seeing her go so far, she has been entered for Shells young business entrepreneur of the year award!! 😀
Jodie

welcome to just parents!
Its always apealed to me to be a landlady but i didn't think you managed to get much time off! plus i never really drink, lol.
Glad you have found something you love, have you been selling tish tash toys for long?
look forward to chatting more
Gemma

I only started selling them middle of February but they just seem to sell themselves.
I sell toys for a very small company at the moment but growing everyday!
I choose whether I want to sell straight from catalogues, do fetes/fairs or party plan etc, I have chosen to do everything I can to maximise my earnings.
I work on commission only, based on total sales of order, there are varied levels of commission dependant on order totals.
Not sure if I can do this but check our range out at
www.tishtashtoys.com
and I think you will see why I am so enthusiastic about my job!!
I hope your sisters shop works for her, she has done extremely well to have acheived so much and not even 18 yet!
sorry Gemma, i meant houses, i have 11 i think, but we are looking into getting a pub too 😀  after much begging from me 😀

my sister is VERY career minded, i was too lazy til i met my chap, i only ever wanted kids! if you was to talk to her you would have thought she was much older than she actually is! im VERY proud of her 😍

You sound like you also have a successful life with 11 houses in your portfolio!
I have to admit my life so far has been children orientated and now I'm trying to get my life up and running, now the littliest is going to start school in Sept I need something to fill my time.

sorry carols and littlelady  i misread the posts and thought yours were both from carol 😊
carols - wish you loads of success with things, i remember my enthusiasm with usborne when i first started too and i don't think its any less now, if you find a product you love then corny as it sounds its not like working at all.   🙂  I actually think it has managed to keep me sane whilst i'm a sahm and means we have extra pennys for days out  😀
littlelady - 11 houses wow!  bet that keeps you busy.  My husband wants to get into buying and doing houses up but i'm a bit nervous...well a bit of a coward when it comes to more debt.
Gemma

depends how you go about it Gemma, if you buy to sell then you really have to look for bargains, we buy and rent them out to people so usualy bring in around £1500+ from each house and each mortgage is about £500, we only make a small profit but we live cosy and have no worrys, its such a change from being a kid, we was brought up on benefits because my dad stole my mums life savings, long story lol, but anyway, think before you jump into things its hard work (i know because i do all the DIY lol) well worth it though 🙂
